newsitem.title: UK: Nationwide to hike mortgage rates Aug. 1.
newsitem.headline: Nationwide to hike mortgage rates Aug. 1.

text.p: British building society Nationwide is to increase its savings and mortgage rates from August 1 in line with the Bank of England's decision last week to raise its official rate to 6.75 percent from 6.25 percent.

Nationwide said its standard variable mortgage rate will be increased to 7.85 percent, up 0.5 percent, while savings rates will be increased across the range of its accounts. It said details of the savings rates increases "will be released in due course".

When the BOE first hiked rates in June, the Nationwide did not follow other banks and building societies in raise its rates. The August 1 hike will be its first since the new Labour government took office in June.
